findings.title: High-severity alerts left open on unverifiable exclusion claim
findings.message: The triage records alerts #1–#3 (including a high-severity x/image alert) as open. Their dispositions rely on the claim that prototypes/p0/gio/go.mod is excluded from the SDK, but that exclusion is asserted only through the self-reported "prototype_files_shipped": 0, with no verifiable evidence. The alerts remain open in the repository, which carries a security risk if the prototype manifest is ever shipped or built.
findings.suggestion: Bump the prototype go.mod dependencies to patched versions, or remove the prototype manifest, so the alerts close. Alternatively, dismiss them with a documented reason (for example, "not used") and add a script-verifiable check that the SDK archive excludes prototypes/.
